title: The recorded ordinary tensor with its quotient-chain augmentation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X. On the completed integral coefficient sheaves define an ordinary ProEtaleTensorModel [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison] by using ambientOrdinaryTensor [lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models] and restricting its ordinary representative comparison along the inclusion of flat-term K-flat complexes into independent-coefficient K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The K-flat equivalence gives a map flat_good into the good class of the recorded integral operations. Define completionChain as the natural quotient Roos augmentation, augmentTensor by whiskering this unit and composing with the Roos image of a strict tensor-tower isomorphism, and quotientChain by applying this construction to total tensor and tensorTowerIso. Its component on (P,Q) is exactly tensorOperationUnit. All data are these specified constructions, with no arbitrary witness chosen.

source.place: Integral reconstruction through thm-sf-pf-adic: coefficient presentation of tensor and its strict quotient augmentation; Bhatt--Scholze 3.4.10, 6.5.5, Stacks 06YY, 07A4, 0941.

proof.text: Convert the ordinary K-flat certificate using isKFlatIndependentCoefficients_iff_isKFlat, keeping termwise flatness. This gives flat_good and the inclusion of the ordinary resolving class in the recorded K-flat class.

Set ordinary tensor to ambientOrdinaryTensor. Whisker ambientTensorModelComparison by the product of the two resolving-class inclusions. Its components give exactly the required signed-total-tensor representative comparison.

Use the already proved sliceRoosUnit_natural identity to prove completionChain_naturality, then make the unit components into completionChain. Whiskering with total tensor and with the strict tensorTowerIso produces quotientChain. Expanding the whiskering components proves quotientChain_app, identifying it with tensorOperationUnit.
